description_detailed: Each mini-medal in this collection features an emblematic element of the Tour (one of the four jerseys, the public or the vehicle) associated with a legendary stage. The seventh mini-medal features the common reverse of the collector coins, representing the graphic elements of the Tour de France.The reverse, common to all the mini-medal, features the Monnaie de Paris logo. The yeardate is inscribed at the bottom. These mini-medals can be collected in a seven-cavity album.
